text:
Marco Silva: Hey @people-ops — quick help please. I had to go to an ER in Barcelona last week (kid had high fever). Hospital said they don’t bill AtlasCare directly so I paid ~€1,250 out of pocket. I submitted a claim and AtlasCare marked it as out-of-network non-emergency and denied. I have the itemized bill, discharge note, and receipts. How do I appeal and get reimbursed? 😕
People Ops: Sorry that happened, Marco. Can you drop the member ID + date of service and attach the PDF of the itemized bill here (or upload to the benefits portal)? We’ll open an appeal and check the emergency clause.
Marco Silva: Member ID 744-22-601, date of service 2025-02-14. Uploading bill now (scanned). Provider name: Hospital Clínic Barcelona. I also have the ER note in Spanish.
benefits-bot: Automated: New request logged BENEFITS-2428 for Marco Silva. Please allow 2 business days for initial review. Link: https://benefits.internal/requests/BENEFITS-2428
Jamal Patel: Got the docs. Preliminary: AtlasCare’s international emergency clause typically covers medically necessary ER visits even out-of-network — reimbursement after claim review. Common issues: missing diagnosis/ER triage note, mismatch in provider name, or receipts not showing payment method. I’ll prepare the appeal packet.
Nadia Ortiz: Two practical items — 1) Insurer needs a translated summary of the ER note (English) for faster processing. We can do a short certified translation if you want. 2) They ask for currency conversion: include a copy of the bank/card statement showing the charge or a conversion table used.
Marco Silva: I can get a bank statement screenshot. For translation, can People Ops confirm you’ll handle it?
People Ops: Yes we can coordinate the translation and add a short attestation letter confirming dates and that this was emergency care while traveling for a covered member. We’ll also request an expedited review citing emergency care and the child’s age.
AtlasCare Support: Hi Marco — this thread was forwarded to our international claims team. For appeal please submit: 1) itemized bill, 2) ER triage/discharge note (English), 3) proof of payment, 4) completed claim form (we’ll attach). Standard turnaround 6-8 weeks; expedited if we have all docs and attestation from employer.
Marco Silva: Thanks. I filled the attached claim form and uploaded everything to the portal. Any chance for an advance or partial reimbursement while this is pending? Hospital sent a 30-day invoice reminder.
Jamal Patel: We can request an advance from AtlasCare (occasionally granted for urgent out-of-pocket bills) if you include invoice and proof of hardship. I’ll add a note requesting advance payment and mark this as high priority.
benefits-bot: BENEFITS-2428 status updated: Appeal packet submitted to AtlasCare by Jamal Patel at 2025-02-15T16:12:05Z.
Nadia Ortiz: FYI: keep copies of receipts and the Spanish medical records. Also save any translation receipts — those are reimbursable as claim-related expenses.
Marco Silva: Really appreciate it. I’ll ping if AtlasCare follows up or needs more docs. Thanks everyone :pray:
